title: Ilumina DNA Prep Part 3 - Clean up Libraries
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Engage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Incubate with magnet
steps.instruction: Wait for 5 minutes with the magnet engaged.

steps.title: Aspirate and transfer supernatant to Plate A
steps.instruction: Aspirate 22.5 µL of supernatant from the sample wells and dispense into Plate A starting at the specified start column.

steps.title: Disengage magnetic module
steps.instruction: Turn off the magnetic module.

steps.title: User plate swap
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol; remove the plate on the magnetic module, replace it with Plate A, and add Plate B to the deck.

steps.title: Pre‑mix diluted beads
steps.instruction: Pre‑mix the 10× diluted beads by pipetting up and down 10 times for the whole run.

steps.title: Add diluted beads to Plate A
steps.instruction: Add 42.5 µL of the diluted beads to each well of Plate A.

steps.title: Mix beads in Plate A
steps.instruction: Mix the contents of each well 10 times.

steps.title: Incubate after bead addition
steps.instruction: Wait for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnet for bead binding
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Incubate with magnet
steps.instruction: Wait for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant to Plate B and mix
steps.instruction: Aspirate 62.5 µL of supernatant from Plate A on the magnetic module, dispense into Plate B (already populated with magnetic beads), and mix 10 times.

steps.title: Incubate after transfer
steps.instruction: Wait for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Swap plates for next step
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol; remove Plate A from the magnetic module and replace it with Plate B.

steps.title: Engage magnet for wash
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Incubate with magnet
steps.instruction: Wait for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 65 µL of supernatant.

steps.title: Add ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of ethanol to each sample well.

steps.title: Incubate ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Wait for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Remove ethanol supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate and discard 200 µL of ethanol supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash steps (add 200 µL ethanol, wait 30 s, remove 200 µL supernatant) as indicated.

steps.title: Remove residual liquid with P20
steps.instruction: Using a P20 pipette, aspirate and discard 20 µL from each well.

steps.title: Incubate before buffer addition
steps.instruction: Wait for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add RSB buffer
steps.instruction: Add 32 µL of RSB buffer to the beads, dispensing on the same side as the beads.

steps.title: Disengage magnet
steps.instruction: Turn off the magnetic module.

steps.title: Resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Incubate after resuspension
steps.instruction: Wait for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Engage magnet for final binding
steps.instruction: Engage the magnetic module.

steps.title: Incubate before elution
steps.instruction: Wait for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Elute final library
steps.instruction: Transfer 30 µL of eluate to Plate C (final elution plate).
